correctness_topical.explantion: Both responses contain factual errors and omissions, but response b is more directly focused on the query about the frequency of innocent (unarmed) victims. This logical inconsistency weakens its argumentative coherence more severely than the formatting and redundancy issues in response b. Consequently, response b demonstrates relatively better logical coherence.
